headings.note: Ezekiel dates by the years of “king Jehoiachin’s captivity”, not by a reigning king; Jehoiachin was then a captive. The text does not explain “the thirtieth year” of 1:1.

statements.why: One vision: begun at 8:1–3, it runs through 9–10 and ends at 11:24 (“So the vision that I had seen went up from me”).
statements.note: Ezekiel counts his years from “king Jehoiachin’s captivity” (1:2); this verse gives the year but names no king, so no ruler is listed.
